name: Double Draw (Lowball)
description: Double Draw (specifically Double Draw Lowball) is a poker variant that expands the traditional Draw Poker format by adding a second opportunity for players to improve their hands. While most commonly played as a 'Lowball' game (where the lowest hand wins), it can also be played for high hands. The extra draw phase significantly increases the chances of completing complex hands but also requires deeper bankroll management and bluffing skills.

content.text: Double Draw (specifically Double Draw Lowball) is a poker variant that expands the traditional Draw Poker format by adding a second opportunity for players to improve their hands. While most commonly played as a 'Lowball' game (where the lowest hand wins), it can also be played for high hands. The extra draw phase significantly increases the chances of completing complex hands but also requires deeper bankroll management and bluffing skills.
Double Draw rose to prominence in the midnd20th century in California card rooms (like Gardena) as a way to increase action and pot sizes in standard Lowball games.
2 to 6 players. Usually played with Blinds (Small and Big).
Poker chips, dealer button, standard deck.
